findings.statement: CA9 is the top convergence gene and is tumour-cell intrinsic: ccRCC cells hold a transcript share of [gene=CA9; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.976] with just over half of tumour cells expressing it, and the paired tumour-cell versus proximal-tubule log2FC is [gene=CA9; type=sc_tumor_vs_pt; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; log2fc=7.739]. Bulk signal is therefore not an infiltration artefact (purity-extrapolated and TCGA layers agree).

In Visium sections the high-CA9 spots are significantly enriched for RCC and, more weakly, macrophage neighbours, and RCC carries nearly all composition-corrected in-situ expression; this is an abundance-weighted neighbourhood enrichment, not a ligand-receptor claim.

AlphaFold model of CA9 (mean pLDDT moderate, a minority of residues confident) has a top cavity of volume [gene=CA9; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; volume_a3=126.8] cubic angstrom lined by high-confidence residues with one accessible lysine; the descriptive score is only moderate and does not identify degrons or predict degradation. Detected cavities recover about half of experimental ligand-contact residues.

CD70 is highest in RCC cells by per-cell level but is also detected in Tregs and other T cells; TCGA replication and purity-extrapolated log2FC remain strongly positive, supporting a tumour-cell contribution (clinical-stage antibodies exist). No selective DepMap dependency and no prognosis signal.

KDR transcripts are endothelial: endothelium holds a share of [gene=KDR; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Endothelial; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.951]; it is a microenvironment (anti-angiogenic) target, not a tumour-cell target.

EPAS1 (HIF-2a) is not mainly tumour-cell in this scRNA dataset: endothelium holds a share of [gene=EPAS1; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Endothelial; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.365] while RCC cells hold only [gene=EPAS1; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.051] with a small fraction of cells detected, so bulk EPAS1 mixes stromal and tumour signal (low detection may also reflect dropout).

MET is mainly tumour-cell: RCC cells hold a transcript share of [gene=MET; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.935], though endothelium shows a higher per-cell fraction relative to its size, so both compartments are potential targets of MET inhibitors.

CD74 is an immune gene: macrophages hold a transcript share of [gene=CD74; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Macrophage; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.436], with dendritic, B and CD8 T cells also near-universally expressing it; any bulk upregulation is immune infiltration, not tumour-cell expression.

CXCR4 is lymphoid: CD8 T cells hold a transcript share of [gene=CXCR4; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=CD8_T; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.563], with CD4 T, B and Treg cells also high; it is an immune microenvironment target.

COL23A1 (tumour track, top-ranked) is made by RCC cells and rises in a pure tumour (purity-extrapolated log2FC [gene=COL23A1; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=tumor; rna_lfc_at_purity1=4.88]), replicates in TCGA, has few ccRCC papers and no clinical drug, is annotated as cell-membrane with low vital-organ RNA; TCGA survival shows no adverse prognosis and DepMap shows no selective dependency, so it is a hypothesis only. Surface call rests on UniProt alone (SURFY nonsurface, not seen in the CSPA surfaceome).

The AlphaFold model of COL23A1 is low confidence (few confident residues) and its only detected cavity has volume [gene=COL23A1; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; volume_a3=8.0] cubic angstrom, so structural tractability by small molecule is poor; antibody targeting of an extracellular domain is the plausible modality. This heuristic does not exclude glue feasibility.

RAB42 (tumour track) is mostly RCC-derived, replicates in TCGA and stays up at purity one with very few ccRCC papers and no clinical drug, but it is an internal protein (not antibody-accessible), has no adverse-survival signal and no selective dependency; low vital-organ RNA. It is an under-studied hypothesis, not a validated target.

OLFML2A (stroma track) is fibroblast-derived, a secreted protein, replicates in TCGA and persists at purity one ([gene=OLFML2A; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=stroma; rna_lfc_at_purity1=1.527]), with few ccRCC papers and no clinical drug; vital-organ RNA is appreciable in colon, there is no adverse prognosis and no selective dependency.

JAG2 (stroma track) is endothelial-attributed, a surface/secreted Notch ligand, replicated in TCGA and purity-robust, with a modest log2FC, a handful of ccRCC papers and no clinical drug; heart-muscle RNA expression is a safety question and no dependency or adverse-prognosis evidence exists.

MILR1 (immune track, top-ranked) is macrophage-derived and linked to adverse TCGA survival, but its purity-extrapolated log2FC collapses to [gene=MILR1; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=immune; rna_lfc_at_purity1=0.414] and it is flagged infiltration-driven, so the bulk rise reflects more macrophages rather than tumour-cell upregulation; no ccRCC papers, no drug, surface protein, but expressed in bone marrow.

LILRB4 (immune track) is macrophage-derived with purity-extrapolated log2FC only [gene=LILRB4; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=immune; rna_lfc_at_purity1=0.508], flagged infiltration-driven; a surface myeloid checkpoint candidate with no clinical drug in this screen but relevant only to tumour-associated macrophage targeting, with lung expression and no dependency evidence.

GAL3ST4 (immune track) is macrophage-derived, TCGA-replicated and adverse for survival, and is called purity-robust although the extrapolated log2FC is small ([gene=GAL3ST4; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=immune; rna_lfc_at_purity1=0.401]); it is an internal enzyme (not antibody-accessible) with one ccRCC paper and no dependency evidence.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses; no selective DepMap dependency was found for any of them, literature is counted by gene symbol, and expression-up does not show the gene is required for growth.
Structure scores describe predicted monomer cavities only; they do not identify degrons, ligase compatibility or degradation.
scRNA-seq has few endothelial, fibroblast and PT cells and few donors for some groups, so low RCC detection of EPAS1 may include dropout; EGFR was not profiled within the call budget.
Convergence ranking also contains many downregulated kidney-specific genes (ALDOB, SLC22A8, UMOD) that are biomarkers of loss of proximal-tubule identity rather than targets.
Normal-tissue protein (GTEx) tool was unavailable in this session; safety relies on HPA RNA values in discovery records.
